svg.title: Xbox controller diagram
svg.desc: Flat drawing of an Xbox controller. Interactive shapes use ControllerInput ids: A, B, X, Y, View, Menu, the D-pad arms, LeftBumper/RightBumper (LB/RB, digital: the inner shoulder shape), LeftTrigger/RightTrigger (LT/RT, the outer shoulder shape) with LeftTriggerFill/RightTriggerFill rising from the bottom in proportion to the pull, and the two thumbstick groups (the stick and cap rings move together; the cap is L3/R3). Glyph strokes carry data-for with the input they mark. The Xbox button is decorative and not interactive.
